verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report confirms n8n keeps execution history and shows what data went in and out of each component. First-party copy claims every step of agent reasoning is traceable on the canvas. However, the pack has no evidence of pinned or sample test data, or of a pre-production test-run mode. Missing for 10: documented data pinning or sample-data testing, a test-before-going-live execution mode, and first-party docs on per-node input/output inspection.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test a workflow with sample or pinned data and inspect each step's input and output before going live

citations.quote: It keeps all the historical executions so you can see what happened when workflows failed and what data was going in/out of each component.
Every step of your agents' reasoning, traceable on the canvas.
